text: The Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) is the largest shareholder of QIIB (Qatar International Islamic Bank), holding 17% of the bank through its subsidiary Qatar Holdings Company; Forbes Middle East reported the stake as 16.62% as of May 2024.
short: QIA is QIIB's largest shareholder, with about 16-17%.

source.name: QIIB: Investors' Presentation HY-2025, 'QIIB Snapshot > Shareholder Structure' (archived 2026-02-07)
source.quote: The Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) is the largest shareholder (17%) of QIIB through its subsidiary, Qatar Holdings Company.
source.note: QIIB's own investor presentation, captured by the Wayback Machine on 2026-02-07. The live copy is qiib.com.qa/Documents/Download/356.
